faux dev diary the knowledge pyramid system hello everyone today were going to talk about one of the biggest reworks weve been prototyping the knowledge pyramid system kps at its heart victoria 3 is a game about societies undergoing industrialization and modernization and we felt that our old model for education and research was too abstract to capture the real forces behind scientific and technological progress the knowledge pyramid system aims to represent how nations actually build sustain and apply knowledge it replaces the old flat research system with a layered approach where the breadth and depth of your populations education directly determines your ability to adopt and innovate technologies research is split in two tabs now science tab knowledge pyramids each has levels 110 for example pops are distributed across levels depending on education institutions and funding mathematics general prerequisite interacts with all others physics chemistry biologylife sciences medicine psychology ecology metallurgy materials science bridge of chemistryphysics geographygeology earth sciences resources surveying social sciences economics sociology statecraft technology tab applied outputs each tech tree advances probabilisticallyemergently based on science depth population distribution networking agriculture crop rotation fertilizers irrigation mechanization gmos later requires biology chemistry geology resource extraction mining oil drilling metallurgy refining energy extraction requires geology metallurgy chemistry mobility transport carts railways motor vehicles aviation space requires physics metallurgy chemistry geography weapons military systems small arms artillery explosives naval warfare tanks aircraft nukes requires physics chemistry metallurgy manufacturing processes textiles mechanized looms assembly lines automation electronics requires physics metallurgy mathematics medicine public health antiseptics vaccines antibiotics surgery hospital systems requires biology life sciences chemistry communications information printing press telegraph radio computing internet requires mathematics physics social science energy systems water mills steam electricity oil nuclear renewables requires physics chemistry metallurgy state society soft tech bureaucracy banking welfare systems democracy propaganda requires social sciences mathematics the pyramid of knowledge each scientific field physics chemistry biology mathematics social sciences etc is represented as a pyramid of levels level 12 basic literacy and numeracy gained from primary education level 34 intermediate understanding taught in secondary schools level 56 advanced theoretical training gained in universities level 7 frontier researchers pushing the boundaries of knowledge sustained through research institutions a countrys pyramid might look like a broad triangle many people at lower levels fewer at higher ones or a thin stick few people with broad foundations but some elite researchers at the top this shape matters enormously a broad base improves technology adoption factories farms and armies can make use of innovations faster because there are enough educated workers and managers to implement them a narrow base with a tall peak improves frontier innovation new inventions may occur but adoption is slow uneven or restricted to certain elites education knowledge flow governments now directly interact with three stages of the knowledge system primarysecondary education expands the base layers of all sciences tertiary education universities produces specialists and researchers increasing higher layers research institutions push the frontier but only if theres a sufficient base beneath them this means education spending and policy choices matter just as much if not more than research spending a nation with glittering universities but no mass schooling may generate breakthroughs but lack the workers engineers and managers to make those breakthroughs transform society networking and diffusion every knowledge level also tracks a networking value stable levels broadly shared knowledge spread innovations quickly frontier levels cuttingedge researchers progress faster when highly networked clustering in universities conferences or through international exchange this adds a new strategic layer countries can accelerate technological adoption not just by research but by building better connectivity between their educated pops technology emergence unlike before technologies are not just unlocked by spending research points instead adoption requires having enough people in relevant knowledge levels and applied sciences eg engineers doctors invention requires a sufficient frontier tier in one or more sciences with probability increased by population size and networking incremental improvements can accumulate if a technology is in use and there are researchers at the right level some technologies will be possible only once new science levels exist for example powered flight requires physics 6 and engineering institutes others are simply refinements that spread faster with broader education applied sciences and professions at the tertiary level we introduce applied sciences institutes engineering schools produce engineers for factories and infrastructure medical schools produce doctors influencing population health management schools produce managers increasing efficiency of industries countries behind in a field can invite foreign experts to seed these institutes giving them a pathway to catch up though relying too much on outsiders can create dependency possible mechanics each tech sector has a frontier level determined by leading nations your nations progress depends on science pyramid depth width in required fields applied science institutes that convert raw knowledge into usable tech networking factor collaboration diffusion journals foreign experts inventions appear probabilistically once requirements are met with faster chances if your pyramid is wellstaffed at the relevant levels incremental improvements happen if enough pops are present in applied institutes so tech is not just research points but emerges from how your knowledge base intersects with sector needs why this matters this system gives us a powerful new lens to represent historical and modern dynamics africa and primitive states many start with almost no base levels in sciences even with universities they struggle because theres no broad foundation this models why adoption lagged despite isolated centers of learning large countries like the us their sheer population ensures deeper pyramids and more frontier researchers creating a natural innovation advantage immigration dynamics highlevel individuals migrate to where their skills are rewarded meaning countries with strong pyramids and high standards of living attract brainpower it also allows us to show why some nations experienced spectacular bursts of growth while others fell into traps of stagnation not because they clicked the wrong production method but because their knowledge foundations were too narrow or disconnected we are eager to listen to your thoughts on this

gas bills 101 this is the companion to my post from last year electricity bills 101 for gas bills warning this is a long and comprehensive post as we need to establish basic principles around utility ratemaking to be able to discuss the topic and address the many misconceptions that i see on every post about rates the goal of this post is to share information about what is a very complex situation to help inform readers about where your money is going what you do with that information is up to you i am not trying to advocate in one direction or another but energy issues are inherently political so its unavoidable these are just the thoughts of someone who has worked in energy policy for over a decade who follows regulatory dockets at the dpu disclosure i have never been employed by or consulted for a nonmunicipal utility in ma in this post ill go over what are all of these charges on my bill how are rates for utilities set in ma why are delivery charges so high what are the gas system enhancement plans gsep why are supply charges so high is it governor healeys fault so what can we do about it tldr gas rates are very complicated and there is not one single reason for our high rates they are the product of many different legislative requirements and other market factors that have added up over many years there are few straightforward answers for bringing down rates what are all of these charges on my bill gas bills are divided into two components supply and delivery supply is the cost to the utilities for buying gas on the open market under state law this is a passthrough cost they cannot profit from the supply market is deregulated though there are no thirdparty suppliers serving the residential market unlike the electric side which has many problems delivery is the cost for all of the infrastructure operations maintenance and profit for the utility as well as charges mandated by public policy its broken up into multiple broad components distribution charge this one seems simple but is perhaps the most complicated and well get into it later the distribution charge is generally considered the cost of service for the utility to distribute gas to its customers the annual cost of service is what is known as the revenue requirement for the utility i will explain more about what the revenue requirement is how its calculated and how it translates in to rates in the next section but lets also importantly note that almost all of the utilitys profit comes from this charge revenue decoupling charge the utility aims to collect its approved revenue requirement through the distribution charge every 6 months if the revenue requirement was not met then the utility recovers the difference over the course of the next 6 months conversely if the utility overcollected they have to give it back a negative charge the intent is that we do not want utilities to earn more profit than they were approved for by encouraging people to the quality of the source you dont need a powerful amp to achieve the sound level but better dongles and cleaner amplification improve control layering and how quiet the background is tuning switches and what they actually do the ce6t has two switches that give you four different configurations in actual use the concept is simple switch 1 boosts the low frequencies it feels like a pleasurable bass boost rather than a messy swell the sub bass gains more noise and the mid bass becomes a little more physical its effect on perceived warmth is noticeable and can make the overall tone feel fuller switch 2 boosts the upper presence area depending on your ear preferences and ear tips you might perceive this as more upper midfrequency energy more treble energy or both the practical result is extra clarity more edge definition and a brighter upper frequency range it also makes the soundstage feel a little more open as its easier to track the upper harmonics with both switches on you get maximum enjoyment and maximum energy with the right music and the right source it can be exciting but if youre sensitive to highs or your source is already clear this is the configuration where youre frequency detail consistent and clear while the bone conduction driver adds a certain shimmering texture that can make cymbals and upper harmonics feel more vibrant especially when you activate the second switch the key word is harmony this is a multi driver iem that sounds like a single voice not like a bunch of different drivers that are usually trying to speak at the same time bass the ce6ts
